allowedSourceMaterial.overview: In 18th century France, the Chevalier de Fronsac and his Native American friend Mani are sent by the King to the Gevaudan province to investigate the killings of hundreds by a mysterious beast.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Sent into a terrified province, two royal investigators must discover whether hundreds have fallen to an ordinary predator or something far more sinister.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In 18th-century France, Chevalier de Fronsac and his companion Mani are dispatched by the King to the Gévaudan province, tasked with hunting down a mysterious beast responsible for hundreds of violent deaths.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful and exciting historical horror; demands engaged attention over a deliberate, medium-paced mystery.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Christophe Gans combines historical drama, horror, and action into a stylish, expansive mystery that treats its beast hunt with ambitious cinematic scale.
